core_obligations: Build the simplicial object (proof lines 2082-2088): from the map of presheaves of sets the author forms the fibre products K'_p = K' x_K ... x_K K' and the associated augmented simplicial object, whose sheafification is a simplicial resolution of K because the map becomes surjective after sheafification.
Identify the E_1 page (proof lines 2088-2092): taking an injective resolution of F and applying the simplicial construction gives a spectral sequence with E_1^{p,q} = H^q(K'_p, F).
Convergence (proof lines 2092-2094): the convergence to H^{p+q}(K, F) follows from the resolution property of the simplicial object.
proof_roadmap: Form the fibre products of K' over K and the associated simplicial object.
Use that the map is surjective after sheafification to get a resolution of K.
Read off the E_1 page and the convergence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a spectral sequence computing the cohomology of K from the cohomology of the fibre products K'_p, for a map of presheaves of sets K' -> K whose sheafification is surjective, with E_1^{p,q} = H^q(K'_p, F) and convergence to H^{p+q}(K, F) (statement lines 2072-2080). The proof builds the simplicial object from the fibre products (proof lines 2082-2088), shows that it resolves K because the map becomes surjective after sheafification, and identifies the E_1 page of the resulting spectral sequence (proof lines 2088-2094). The non-formal content is the use of sheafification to obtain the resolution. The claim is H2: one construction plus one page identification.
